corpus.provenance: Synthetic. Generated locally from a fixed seed by bench/corpora/ai-v1/generate.go. No downloaded, scraped, production, or Meta data is present. Values are patterns chosen to exercise near-duplicate, tensor, token, and checkpoint paths; they have no scientific meaning.

notes: All sizes are bytes. `visible_bytes` is the manifest's declared visible representation; for TENSOR it is the element payload and for TOKENS it is the canonical delta-LEB128 payload, while `source_bytes` is the JSON/text file.

`physical_bytes` counts every stored frame/chunk/index/manifest once for the whole corpus; `pair_bytes` sums marginal + base plaintext per dependent object and therefore may double-count shared bases.
`read_latency_ns` is the median of verified decodes; `historical_read_ns` uses the cold dependency-DAG path when the object has a relation chain, otherwise the warm path.
CDC is content-only and relation-agnostic. WeftCodec context bases come only from declared typed relations in the manifest.
No winner or superiority claim is made. See bench/RESULTS-ai-v1.md for the analysis and every loss.

cdc_zstd.description: Gear-hash content-defined chunking (min 2 KiB, avg 8 KiB, max 32 KiB), global dedup by H(weft/chunk/v1), zstd level 3 per unique chunk.
